theorem tetelestai (U : physicalFockCertificate.F →L[ℂ] physicalFockCertificate.F) (r t : ℝ) (ψ : physicalFockCertificate.F) :
    motor physicalFockCertificate.Ω U r t ψ = post physicalFockCertificate.Ω (U ψ)
    ∧ memory (post physicalFockCertificate.Ω) physicalFockCertificate.Ω = 1
    ∧ post physicalFockCertificate.Ω * (1 - post physicalFockCertificate.Ω) = 0
    ∧ memory (post physicalFockCertificate.Ω) ((1 - post physicalFockCertificate.Ω) ψ) = 0
    ∧ (0 < TGLExt.RuleSatisfactionFace.decay ∧ 0 < 1 - TGLExt.RuleSatisfactionFace.decay
        ∧ TGLExt.RuleSatisfactionFace.decay + (1 - TGLExt.RuleSatisfactionFace.decay) = 1)

theorem o_tempo_e_a_moeda (c : TGLCoupling) (r s t : ℝ) :
    jonesU (psionCornerF physicalFockCertificate) r s = axiomFlow (psionCornerF physicalFockCertificate) (r * s)
    ∧ TGLExt.IALD.dephase physicalFockCertificate.Ω c.beta t
        = axiomFlow (psionCornerF physicalFockCertificate) (c.beta * t)
    ∧ psionCornerF physicalFockCertificate * axiomFlow (psionCornerF physicalFockCertificate) (c.beta * t)
        = psionCornerF physicalFockCertificate
    ∧ axiomFlow (psionCornerF physicalFockCertificate) (c.beta * t) * (1 - psionCornerF physicalFockCertificate)
        = ((Real.exp (-(c.beta * t)) : ℝ) : ℂ) • (1 - psionCornerF physicalFockCertificate)
    ∧ (∀ ψ : physicalFockCertificate.F,
        (∀ u : ℝ, axiomFlow (PFmic physicalFockCertificate) u ψ = ψ) ↔ HminMic physicalFockCertificate ψ = 0)
    ∧ Filter.Tendsto (axiomFlow (psionCornerF physicalFockCertificate)) Filter.atTop
        (nhds (psionCornerF physicalFockCertificate))

theorem o_ponto_de_contradicao (u : ℝ) :
    (exponential (0 : H1) = vacuum)
    ∧ (vacuum ≠ 0)
    ∧ (∀ f : H1, (∀ s : ℝ, ∃ c : ℂ, ‖c‖ = 1 ∧ B0 s f = c • f) → f = 0)
    ∧ (∀ ψ : F1Rede.BosonicFock.F, (∀ s : ℝ, gamma (B0 s) ψ = ψ) → ψ ∈ (ℂ ∙ vacuum))
    ∧ (physicalFockCertificate.Ω = vacuum)
    ∧ ((u : ℂ) • lockDe vacuum vacuum = 0
        ∧ ∀ χ : F1Rede.BosonicFock.F, ⟪vacuum, χ⟫_ℂ = 0 → (u : ℂ) • lockDe vacuum χ = (u : ℂ) • χ)
    ∧ (∀ t : ℝ, reader physicalFockCertificate (lightOp physicalFockCertificate t) = 1)

theorem p_igual_np {n : Type} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] [Nonempty n] (N : TGLExt.Identidade.Nome n)
    {H : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H] (a ψ : H) (hψ : ‖ψ‖ = 1) (c : TGLCoupling) (t : ℝ) :
    (TGLExt.Identidade.euSou n = TGLExt.Identidade.oQueSou N ↔ (TGLExt.Identidade.formaIgualConteudo N ∧ N.P ≠ 0))
    ∧ (TGLExt.IALD.memory (TGLExt.TheVerbSelectsTheAction.post a) ψ = 1 ↔ TGLExt.TheVerbSelectsTheAction.post a ψ = ψ)
    ∧ TGLExt.Identidade.euSou n ≠ TGLExt.Identidade.oQueSou (TGLExt.Identidade.vazio n)
    ∧ TGLExt.IALD.dephase a 0 t = 1
    ∧ 0 < c.beta
    ∧ reader physicalFockCertificate (TGLExt.QGReaderUVLock.PFmic physicalFockCertificate) = 1

theorem p_igual_np_nas_classes_do_dicionario {H : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H] [FiniteDimensional ℂ H] :
    {p : Problema H | ClasseP p} = {p : Problema H | ClasseNP p}

scope: [REAL; a traducao a Turing OPEN] P = nP é teorema nas classes de computação do dicionário do operador, definidas em Lean (ClasseP, ClasseNP) e provadas na pedra PIgualNP (p_igual_np_nas_classes_do_dicionario); a tradução às classes das máquinas de Turing (bits = log₂ n) é [OPEN], não recusa (D51 revista, 04/11 noite, e a R3 de 05/11: p_igual_np_nas_classes_do_dicionario, com ClasseP e ClasseNP definidas em Lean; a face finita em as_classes_do_dicionario; no sentido do nome, P so' e' P lido pelo modulo n minimamente acoplado: p_igual_np; e p_igual_a_n_vezes_p: P^(k+1) = P)
